scripts.db:local:init: wrangler d1 execute rolemi-metrics --local --file=sql/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute rolemi-metrics --local --file=sql/event-aggregates.sql
scripts.db:local:tables: wrangler d1 execute rolemi-metrics --local --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
scripts.db:prod:init: wrangler d1 execute rolemi-metrics --remote --env production --file=sql/schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute rolemi-metrics --remote --env production --file=sql/event-aggregates.sql
scripts.db:prod:tables: wrangler d1 execute rolemi-metrics --remote --env production --command="SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' ORDER BY name;"
